rationale: Pulp's plug-in telemetry publishes MeterFrame and VectorFrame from an audio or host thread through TripleBuffer. Their fixed-capacity layouts already document trivial copyability as the condition that keeps publication allocation-free and non-blocking, but only the newer event payloads enforced that condition at compile time. The header now rejects any future field change that would violate the promised payload contract, and the focused value-channel test pins both frame traits. This is Pulp-specific plug-in telemetry hardening; it adds no Vellum API or framework behavior to backport.
